Make sure our units can see them!|audio = BathroomApproachWave 4 3.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 12 ([[Bathroom Approach]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Spy Ducky''' was a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy that appeared in [[Bathroom Approach]] as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] and its rerun in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. It has decent health and an above average speed. ==Logbook Description== "''Spy Ducky is a ghost, a mystery. He changes disguises faster than one could quack. Infiltrating the highest level of government secrets and being internationally wanted for espionage, Spy Ducky could be a villain in his own right. He could be anywhere, anything, anyone. Spy Ducky could even{{sic}} you.''" ==Appearance== The '''Spy Ducky''' is a regular yellow duck with black eyes, orange beak and orange flippers. It wears a brown hat and a mask. As it is a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy, its body is entirely translucent. It has three animations that it can randomly have, where all three also have differently shaped eyes. The first animation has it have a happy expression, the second has it have a serious expression while the third one has its eyes partially closed, likely because it is scared. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Bathroom Approach]] is listed instead. *Towers with hidden detection that are effective early on are pretty useful against the '''Spy Ducky'''. Such towers include the [[Ace Pilot]], [[Crook Boss]], [[Militant]] and [[Cowboy]]. **The [[Golden Crook Boss]] and [[Golden Cowboy]] are more effective against it, although not required. **The [[Ace Pilot]] can also be used to give towers which normally do not have hidden detection, like the [[Mortar]] or [[Pursuit]], hidden detection, making the '''Spy Ducky''' far easier to deal with. *Like all [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies, towers with splash damage or multi-targeting, such as the [[Mortar]] and [[Electroshocker]] can damage them without hidden detection. These should not be entirely relied on, and should be backed up by the above towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1SpyDucky1.png|Green variant, current version, first animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1SpyDucky2.png|Green variant, current version, second animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1SpyDucky3.png|Green variant, current version, third animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseSpyDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Ducky Battlepass - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Spy Ducky''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Ducky Revenge Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Spy Ducky''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} SpyDuckyIconIG.png|'''Spy Ducky''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Spy Ducky''' is based on the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Spy Spy] from ''Team Fortress 2''. **The last sentence of its [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description is a reference to [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OR4N5OhcY9s Meet The Spy]. *The '''Spy Ducky''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 April 2025''' -
